prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-resolution 4:5 dynamic Nike fashion action photograph in a clean gradient blue studio. Show an adult woman with a feminine athletic silhouette, flowing wavy gray-blue hair, natural skin texture, and focused energetic expression, caught mid-air in a powerful leap. She wears light blue-framed sunglasses, small hoop earrings, a white cropped puffer jacket with light blue panels, a white bandeau top layered beneath, a light blue utility harness, oversized gray-olive cargo pants with multiple pockets and light blue straps, chunky white socks with a blue Nike swoosh, and intricate light blue Nike Air Max-style sneakers. Freeze the motion with asymmetrically bent knees, slight torso twist, flowing hair and straps, a polished blue floor reflection, giant vertical white +tsun typography on the right, and Nike campaign copy on the left. Use crisp even studio light, technical fabric detail, accurate legible text, and no watermark or extra text.
